name: Theta Vantage Desk
tagline: An options briefing desk: gamma, flow and volatility on one ticker
description: Name a symbol and an expiry and it assembles the desk view sitting behind that trade: where dealers are positioned, how the contracts are changing hands, what volatility is currently pricing in, and which price levels matter. What comes back is a read to shape your own decision, not an order to place.
author: ThetaVantage
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
